data.narrative:
ARX Robotics is a Series A-stage defense and security robotics company that has raised €42M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of 10 peers (2 public, 8 private), including same-stage companies such as Stark Defence, Singularity, and NODA AI, alongside established players like Anduril Industries and Helsing.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the €42M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage transitions, yielding €84M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Stark Defence (€4.0B), Singularity (€400M), and NODA AI (€125M)—produces a median valuation of €400M, with a range spanning €125M to €4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects material differences in technology maturity, customer validation, or fundraising dynamics within the Defense & Security robotics segment.

Triangulating these methods yields a valuation range of €71M (low) to €460M (high), with a median of €242M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound; peer median drives the midpoint. Key uncertainties include the relevance of the €4.0B Stark Defence outlier to ARX's specific trajectory and whether ARX's customer traction or IP defensibility justifies positioning at or above the peer median. Additional data on customer concentration, technical differentiation, and defense procurement timelines would refine confidence in this range.
